name: Image
summary: A picture in a frame of a fixed shape that holds its space while it loads, shows a soft fill while it waits, and says what it was when it can't load. With a caption or a credit it becomes a figure.
a11y: A native `img` with its alternative text; `alt=""` hides a decorative picture from screen readers. With a caption it is a `figure` and its `figcaption`, so the caption is read with it. A picture that can't load shows an alternative text as words in the frame, with an icon by default, so nothing is silently missing. Lazy by default; the frame's ratio (or `width` and `height`) reserves its space, so the page doesn't shift as it arrives.

props.name: src
props.description: The picture's address.

props.name: alt
props.description: What the picture shows, for people who can't see it. `""` when it only decorates (the words beside it say it all).

props.name: srcSet
props.description: Other widths of the same picture, for the browser to pick from (`srcset`).

props.name: sizes
props.description: How wide the picture is drawn at each window width (`sizes`), so the browser picks the right file.

props.name: ratio
props.description: The frame's shape: `ultrawide` 21:9 (a band or banner), `wide` 16:9, `photo` 3:2, `classic` 4:3, `square` 1:1, `portrait` 4:5, or `natural` (the picture's own; give `width` and `height`).

props.name: focal
props.description: The point to keep in the frame when `cover` crops (IP12): `x` and `y` from 0 to 1, across from the start edge and down from the top, e.g. `{ x: 0.3, y: 0.2 }` for a face up and to one side. The centre (0.5, 0.5) when left out. The same field as a picture entry's `focal` in `assets.json`.

props.name: fit
props.description: `cover` fills the frame and crops the edges (default); `contain` shows the whole picture inside the frame.

props.name: fallbackLayout
props.description: `stack` (default) shows an icon and the alt text on failure. `label` uses the full alt text alone with a smaller inset, for short names in shallow frames; reserve enough space for the label. An empty alt still shows the decorative icon.

props.name: surface
props.description: The frame's fill while the picture waits and behind transparent art: `sunken` (default), or `none` for a picture that sits on a surface of its own (a logo on a tile), so the waiting shimmer and the art show on that surface and no second box appears.

props.name: width
props.description: The picture's own width and height in pixels: they reserve its space before it loads, so nothing below it jumps.

props.name: caption
props.description: What the picture shows or why it's here, under it. Makes it a figure.

props.name: credit
props.description: Who made it, after the caption.

props.name: rounded
props.description: Rounded corners (default), or square for a picture that meets the edge of its container. In a Card's media slot the card owns the corners, so the picture is square there either way.

props.name: loading
props.description: `lazy` (default) loads it when it nears the window; `eager` for the first picture a page shows.

props.name: priority
props.description: The picture the page is waiting for (its largest, first in view): loads at once, ahead of other pictures (`fetchpriority="high"`). One per page at most.

props.name: treatment
props.description: A treatment (IP31), named as a picture entry's `treatment` in `assets.json` (DP3): `'greyscale'`, `'duotone'` (grey multiplied over `--c-image-duotone`, the accent by default) or `'none'`; or `{ rest, active }`, where `active` shows while the picture, or the link, button or card around it, is hovered or focused (`{ rest: 'greyscale', active: 'none' }`: grey until pointed at). More contrast and forced colours always show the picture as it is.

props.name: dark
props.description: The picture drawn in a dark scheme (MP17): another file of the same picture, at the same ratio, under the same `alt`. `src` stays the light (or only) file. It follows the nearest `data-scheme` (the page's, or a band's own), else the system's; swaps before the first paint and, later, only once the new file has loaded, so nothing flashes or moves. Only the file in use is fetched until the scheme changes. Raster or SVG alike.

props.name: contrast
props.description: Files for more contrast (MP17), in light and in dark. Falls back: dark and more → `contrast.dark` → `dark` → `src`; light and more → `contrast.light` → `src`.

props.name: decoration
props.description: Shapes drawn over the picture (MP8): a brand's marks, dots or a frame. The layer is the picture's own size; an SVG in it fills it, and shapes drawn outside its viewBox spill past the picture's edge (the picture keeps its corners). Shapes in `currentColor` take `--c-image-decoration` (the accent). Hidden from screen readers, never takes the pointer or focus, and never changes the layout; describe the picture in `alt` as before.

props.name: under
props.description: The same as `decoration`, drawn behind the picture: seen only where it spills past the picture's edge.

props.name: room
props.description: Room kept around the picture inside its box for its `under` and `decoration` art (a frame), as CSS padding (`'4% 4% 5% 5%'`; percentages of the box's width): the picture shrinks so the art's spill stays in the box and never reaches a neighbour. The picture and its art are then one isolated group: art drawn with a blend mode blends with the picture, never with the page. Only with `under` or `decoration`.

props.name: alternate
props.description: A paired picture (MP10): an after to `src`'s before, a product's other side. It shows while the picture, or the link, button or card around it, is hovered or focused (the same as `treatment`'s `active`), crossfading on the change duration (kept under reduced motion, as a fade). Fetched only on the first hover or focus. Same shape as the picture; screen readers keep `alt`, so say both there ("Before and after: …").

props.name: reveal
props.description: Draws the change to `alternate` yourself (MP11): a wipe, a stipple. Called on every animation frame while it runs with a canvas over the picture, the eased progress (0 → 1 and back) and `paint` to draw either picture as the frame fits it. The library owns the triggers (as `alternate`), the timing (`--c-image-reveal-duration`) and reduced motion, where it isn't called and the pair crossfades in over the resting tone instead, on `--c-image-reveal-reduced-duration` (default the change duration). Needs `alternate`. With a `treatment` whose `active` differs, the tone holds at rest while a reveal carries the change (the reveal owns it). A template's reveal presets (`registry.reveals`) reach a picture through its block's `reveal`.

settings.description: How long a drawn reveal (Image reveal, a template's reveal preset) takes from the picture to its pair (default duration.xslow, 400 ms). A brand whose reveal is a slow effect sets a longer time; reduced motion never draws it.

With reduced motion a reveal isn't drawn: the pair crossfades in over the resting tone for this long (default duration.change, 200 ms). A brand whose approved reduced-motion fade is shorter or longer sets it.
